'''Version 1.4.0''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on December 8th 2019.  It was 2.44 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

* Changed [[Primitive Yelloweye|emana]] model
* Changed base value for the following mobs:
*#    Emana Health from 20 to 13
*#    Emana Armor from 5 to 0.2
*#    Emana KD Resistance from 0.9 to 0.1
*#    [[Assimilated Human|Infected Human]] Health from 20 to 21
*#    Infected Human Damage from 4.5 to 5.5
*#    Infected Human Armor from 7 to 3
*#    Infected Human KD Resistance from 1.1 to 0.2
*#    [[Buglin|Lodo]] Health from 6 to 3
*#    Lodo Armor from 10 to 0.2
*#    Lodo Damage from 2 to 1.1
*#    Lodo KD Resistance from 0.5 to 0.1

* Changed [[Flying Carrier|Buthol]] mob name for Nithol
* Changed how [[Summoner (Disambiguation)|Canra]] summon mobs (now it has a cooldown, previously you only need to hurt it)
* Changed [[Assimilated Big Spider|Dorpa]] projectile, now it will spawn a maximum of 3 web blocks
* [[Heavy Carrier|Rathol]] will spawn 4 [[Rupter|Mudo]] mobs on explotion
* Rathol will explote when its remaining life is below 5%
* Added more options to the configuration file
* Added loot table for [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted versions]] ( Now they have 2 loot tables and 1 is choosen by rng )

==== <u>New Content</u> ====

* Added infected versions of the following mobs:
*# [[Assimilated Cow|Cow]]
*# [[Assimilated Sheep|Sheep]]
*# [[Assimilated Wolf|Wolf]]

* Added an [[Adapted Yelloweye|Adapted version]] for the [[Primitive Yelloweye|Emana]] mob
* Added ambient, hurt and death sounds for the following mobs:
*# [[Primitive Summoner|Canra]] (and [[Adapted Summoner|adapted version]])
*# [[Primitive Reeker|Nogla]] (and [[Adapted Reeker|adapted version]])
*# Emana (and adapted version)
*# [[Primitive Longarms|Shyco]] (and [[Adapted Longarms|adapted version]])
*# [[Primitive Manducater|Hull]] (and [[Adapted Manducater|adapted version]])
*# [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Infected versions]]

* Added esplotion sound for the [[Heavy Carrier|Rathol]] and [[Flying Carrier|Nithol]]
* Added a new mob: [[Rupter|Mudo]]
*#    This little guy will attack and infect cows, sheeps, wolfs and zombies (Optional)

Sound effects obtained from https://www.zapsplat.com/
